decisions.reason: Changing the score heading, prominence, spacing, and visibility does not alter the separately defined result-driver content or bullet-point format. Its same-message MODIFY is independently supported by item 3.
The front-page score refinement does not change the final-page distribution warning. The warning requirements come from a separate clause in the source message.

Renaming the displayed score heading does not remove or change the requirement that the security score remain editable. The assessment-date formatting change is independently supported by another clause.

The score changes apply to the front-page result panel and do not necessarily alter the coverage, presentation, or text of internal-page headers. The existing same-message header change is independently supported by item 7.
Score prominence and heading changes do not alter how the vehicle group or assessed vehicle is displayed. The candidate's same-message changes are independently supported by item 6.
The localized front-page score refinement remains compatible with the existing visual theme and does not require changing its current design direction, reference, or cross-variant application.
Renaming the front-page score heading to Vehicle Security Score does not change the DX-17 identifier required in internal-page headers.
The score heading and prominence changes do not alter the candidate's assessment-date copy policy. That policy is independently established by item 4.
The front-page score refinement does not change footer presence or required footer content.
The source decision changes the front-page score display, not the separate scoring-summary table, its format, or its required fields.
The score display refinement does not change the recommendation style or priority tiers.
The front-page score heading and visual prominence changes do not alter the required DX17-DX20 variant set, editability, or risk-based selection rule.
